definition_and_notes: Unique synthetic observation identifier.
Start of the hourly observation interval; local time is represented without an explicit timezone suffix.
Calendar date extracted from timestamp_local.
Hour of day extracted from timestamp_local.
Weekday name.
1 for Saturday or Sunday; otherwise 0.
Calendar month.
Synthetic South-Indian-style seasonal grouping: Cool/Dry, Hot/Pre-monsoon, Southwest monsoon, Northeast monsoon.
Stable identifier for one of the 24 synthetic street segments.
Synthetic label; not a real street name or address.
Residential, Arterial, Commercial, Industrial, Campus, or Highway.
Road-use classification assigned to the synthetic segment.
LED or High-pressure sodium (HPS).
Fixed, Scheduled dimming, or Adaptive dimming.
Number of luminaires connected to the street segment's simulated lighting circuit.
Rated input power per luminaire.
Synthetic vehicle count during the hourly interval.
Synthetic pedestrian count during the hourly interval.
Synthetic city-level hourly class: Clear, Partly cloudy, Cloudy, Rain, or Thunderstorm.
Synthetic hourly temperature with small street-level sensor noise.
Synthetic relative humidity; limited to a plausible 20–100% range.
Synthetic precipitation amount during the hourly interval.
Synthetic cloud-cover estimate, 0–100%.
Synthetic visibility estimate, bounded to 0.4–12 km.
Synthetic natural ambient-light sensor reading. A small number of readings are intentionally missing or contain flagged sensor spikes.
Simulated operating decision based on latent ambient light being below 50 lux; a flagged ambient-sensor fault may therefore disagree with the recorded value.
Synthetic target illuminance assumption based on zone/road type; this is a planning feature, not a measured road-surface result.
Controller-requested lamp level, 0–100%.
Simulated measured lamp level, with small measurement noise and zeros during simulated outages/off periods.
Off, On, Dimmed, or Fault. Faults are simulated operational outages.
Simulated circuit energy for the hourly interval, including a small standby draw. It is not a real meter reading.
Synthetic comparator: rated full output while lighting is required, plus small controller standby when lighting is not required.
Record-level comparison against full_output_reference_kwh. Excluded for simulated lighting faults and flagged energy-meter spikes; not a validated city-wide saving estimate.
1 when a sensor anomaly, meter spike, or selected sensor missingness is deliberately injected.
Semicolon-separated anomaly description(s), or None.
OK, Sensor issue, or Lighting fault. Sensor issue takes precedence if both are present.
